messages.subject: [aroma.affymetrix] PCR fragment-length effect normalization error for  Mapping250K chips
parts:
I am using 64-bit version R-2.10.1 on Mac.
I was following the vignette "estimation of total copy number using the CRMA v2 method (10K-GWS6)" using a dataset of Mapping250K_Sty platform.
Everything worked out fine until the step4 - Normalization for PCR fragment-length effects where I got following:

...
plm <- RmaCnPlm(csN, mergeStrands=TRUE, combineAlleles=TRUE)
print (plm) ## worked OK!

ces <- getChipEffectSet(plm)
print (ces) ## worked OK!

fln <- FragmentLengthNormalization(ces, target="zero")
print (fln) ## worked OK!

cesN <- process(fln, verbose=verbose)
